name: Kletterbox Ravensburg
day_pass: €16 adult (non-member), €13 members of other DAV sections
notes: DAV Sektion Ravensburg hall (school sports hall, mainly rope climbing, small boulder area). Hours as stated; a line 'Bis einschliesslich 30.08. 12:00 bis 19:00 Uhr' sits between Sunday and holidays and was ignored as seasonal/ambiguous. Price list valid from 01.01.2026: adult day ticket 16 non-member, 13 other-section member, 11 own-section member. Rental shoes 4.50. kletterbox-ravensburg.de and kletterbox.de are not the gym (kletterbox.de is a parked for-sale page); the official site is kletterbox.com. Pin check (Nominatim Bruehlstr. 31): about 1.0 km from our pin, same town.

name: Kletterwerk Radolfzell
notes: DAV Sektion Konstanz hall. Hours as stated (Mo/We/Fr 15-22:30, Tu/Th 9-22:30, Sa/Su/holidays 10-21; may close early at low attendance). Prices page is marked 'gueltig seit 01.01.2023' so day_pass left null. Facilities: Bistro, Shop, Trainingsraum (campus board, gym equipment), Kinderbereich. Equipment rental mentioned only generally, so shoe-hire not set. Pin check: 0.4 km from our pin.

name: Alte Ziegelei Boulderhalle Straubing
notes: Hours deliberately null: the Oeffnungszeiten block reads 'Montag -Mittwoch - Donnerstag 13:00-22:30; Dienstag 10:00-22:30; Freitag 10:00-21:00; Sa/So/Feiertag 08:30-20:00'. The Monday label is ambiguous (looks like Mon, Wed, Thu but written like a range), so it was not read through. Day pass: regular 14.20, concession 12.50 (Early Bird Mo-Fr 10-14: 12.50 regular). Facilities: Bistro, LED Moonboard/campus/spray wall, Kinderbouldern, rental shoes, free parking in front of the hall. Pin check: 0.7 km from our pin.

name: Blockhelden Boulderhalle Bamberg
notes: Page states 'jeden Tag 9-23 Uhr'. Day ticket adult 15 (Mo-Fr from 15:00, Sa/So/holidays/school holidays), 14 for Mo-Fr before 15:00; concession 13/12. Facilities: Bistro, Kraftraum, Kinderbereich, rental shoes 4. A Yoga Loft is described but not as classes, so yoga not set. name: Boulder House Rödental
day_pass: €13.90 adult, €11.90 concession (Cogito hall); BoulderHouse kids/family hall €9.90
notes: boulderhouse-roedental.de now redirects to cogito-coburg.de ('Cogito | BoulderHouse', Brueckenstrasse 6, Roedental). The site now has an adult hall 'Cogito' (single entry 13.90/11.90) and 'BoulderHouse' converted to a kids/family hall (single entry 9.90) which is closed for rebuild until mid-October 2026. Hours Mo-So 8-22 for the venue. Facilities: rental shoes, training/technique areas (Cogito), kids/family hall. Pin check: Nominatim finds Brueckenstrasse 6 in Moenchroeden/Roedental about 5 km SW of our pin.

name: Bouldertreff Illschwang
notes: Entry needs a 'boulder card' (5 euro, bought in the freizeit-outdoor shop, prepaid credit). Prices per 4 hours: adults 7.00, 14-17 5.50, children 4.00. Training wall upstairs, parking in the yard, equipment shop on site, Kindergeburtstage page (kids). No shoe hire (page says so). Pin check: Gewerbepark 3 in Illschwang is about 6 km NNW of our pin.

name: Boulderwelt Regensburg
notes: Hours Mo-Fr 7-23, Sa/So/holidays 8-23. Price table identical to the other Boulderwelt halls (prime time normal 16.90, concession 12.90). Cafe, training area with Kilterboard/campus, kids area (300 m2 Kinderwelt) and shoe rental stated. A 'Shop' appears only as a menu label so not set. Pin check: Im Gewerbepark A46 is about 2.9 km NE of our pin (city centre).

name: DAV Kletter Boulder Zentrum Landshut
notes: Opening times listed Mo 14-22, Tu 10-22, We/Th/Fr 14-22, Sa/Su 10-20 (holidays 10-20) but the same page adds 'Ab 17.04.2026 oeffnen wir freitags um 10:00 Uhr', so Friday is set to 10am (judgement call). Climbing stops 15 min before closing. Price list 'Stand 01.01.2026': non-member adult day ticket 15 (climbing+bouldering), 10.50 bouldering only; DAV members pay less. Facilities: cafe/bistro, rental shoes, boulder hall with campus board and system wall, kids courses/birthday, yoga course. Pin check: Ritter-von-Schoch-Str. 6 is about 2.5 km NE of our pin.

name: DAV Kletterzentrum Regensburg
notes: Hours Mo-So 10-22. The entry price page says 'gueltig ab 01.01.2024' (older than one year; the table itself is not in the page text), so day_pass null. Facilities per 'Zahlen und Fakten': Bistro KletterBar, system wall/campus board, separate kids boulder area, showers, free parking. Rental is only stated as 'Ausruestungsverleih', so shoe-hire not set. The hall is in Lappersdorf/Kareth, not Regensburg proper: official address about 3.8 km N of our pin.

name: Der Steinbock

Web search for 'Steinbock Boulderhalle Straubing' returns only Boulderhalle Straubing (Alte Ziegelei) and der steinbock Passau. Likely a mis-located duplicate of der steinbock Passau, or of the Straubing hall about 0.4 km from our pin.

name: Kletterhalle Bernau
notes: DAV Sektion Prien hall. Page says there is no regular public operation, only fixed group times, with volunteer-supervised open climbing sessions (e.g. Mo 18-21, Tu 18:30-21:30, Fr 9:30-11:30 and 18-20); guests can pay the supervisor (cash only; guest adult 7.50, but labelled with 'Jahreskarte 2025', so not treated as a current price). Counted as operating with limited public access; no public hours or day pass set. Domain kletterhalle-bernau.de is a parked page, not the club. Pin check: Buchenstrasse 17 in Bernau is about 4.6 km from our pin (Nominatim result may be approximate).
